statements.proposition: This change adds test files for core modules including EnvilderFactory and AwsSsmStoreSecrets.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Both named test files are newly added. The AwsSsmStoreSecrets test is a LocalStack/testcontainers integration test rather than a strict unit test, and EnvilderFactory.test.ts tests EnvilderBuilder; labelled on the files-scope reading (tests added for these modules). The purpose clause 'to ensure the test suite passes' was not checked (would need Docker/LocalStack).
